title: cn_antibiotics: harmonized environmental antibiotics, CARSS resistance, and China yearbook covariates
description: R pipeline that turns literature-derived environmental antibiotic concentrations (harmonized from Zhang et al. 2022 Figshare https://doi.org/10.6084/m9.figshare.19692241.v1 plus supplemental literature; we did not generate those primary occurrence rows), CARSS clinical resistance data, and NBS China Statistical Yearbook variables into analysis-ready tables. Curated data: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.22807175 (CC BY 4.0 on the curation layer). SimpleMaps China provinces shapefile (CC BY 4.0; attribute https://simplemaps.com) is used for maps in this repository and is not part of the Zenodo data zip.
